description: Unit test code for path builder and certificate revocation list (CRL) handling in the net::cert::pki namespace, specifically testing PKITS (Public Key Infrastructure Testing) scenarios.

classes.name: CrlCheckingPathBuilderDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for CRL checking during path building, extends SimplePathBuilderDelegate to include CRL revocation checks.

classes.name: PathBuilderPkitsTestDelegate
classes.description: Test delegate class that sets up and runs PKITS test scenarios for certificate path validation, including CRL handling and test-specific logic.

methods.name: CheckPathAfterVerification
methods.description: Overrides the base method to perform CRL revocation checks on certificates in the path after verification.

methods.name: RunTest
methods.description: Static method to set up and execute a PKITS test scenario with given certificates, CRLs, and test info.
